description: Checkbox does this itself once the plan is done; call it if you stop earlier. Marks the setup finished and emails the person who approved it "<agent> set up Checkbox for <domain>" with what was created, what is still open, the go-live steps and a review link. Idempotent: the email is sent once. Monitoring keeps running. In test mode it returns go_live: tell the human go_live.summary ("set up in test mode; N steps before real customers"), never just "done".

setup_session.description: Setup session id (setup_…). Default: the newest one.

name: complete_setup
title: Finish setup and email the human a summary
